doc.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Meeting Scott Hamilton
summary: Hamilton was his hero; they never discussed what he thinks while playing.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: When you first met Scott, it must have been kind of a thrill after listening to his records for all those years.
Oh, absolutely. He was my hero.
Has he described to you what he thinks about when he plays?
No we never had any discussions like that.
He’s mostly self taught, isn’t he?
